datasets.name: 53e554e3
datasets.displayName: Top Campaign Channel Performance Metrics Overview
queryLines:
SELECT 
    dc.campaign_name,
    dch.channel_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key) as customers_reached,
    SUM(f.converted_count) as conversions,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as revenue,
    SUM(f.converted_count) / COUNT(f.communication_id) as conversion_rate
FROM 
    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
JOIN 
    workspace.crm_info.dim_campaign dc ON f.campaign_key = dc.campaign_id
JOIN 
    workspace.crm_info.dim_channel dch ON f.channel_key = dch.channel_id
GROUP BY 
    dc.campaign_name, dch.channel_name
ORDER BY 
    revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

datasets.name: 3a0083f7
datasets.displayName: Daily Summary of Communication Metrics and Engagement (over the last 30 days)
queryLines:
SELECT 
    dd.date,
    dd.day_name,
    dd.is_weekend,
    COUNT(f.communication_id) as communications_sent,
    SUM(f.delivered_count) as delivered,
    SUM(f.opened_count) as opened,
    SUM(f.clicked_count) as clicked,
    SUM(f.converted_count) as conversions,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as revenue,
    SUM(f.converted_count) / COUNT(f.communication_id) as conversion_rate,
    SUM(f.opened_count) / SUM(f.delivered_count) as open_rate
FROM 
    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
JOIN 
    workspace.crm_info.dim_date dd ON f.date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE 
    dd.date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY 
    dd.date, dd.day_name, dd.is_weekend
ORDER BY 
    dd.date DESC;

datasets.name: 036acd4c
datasets.displayName: Channel Performance Metrics with ROI and Conversion Insights
queryLines:
SELECT 
    dch.channel_name,
    dch.channel_type,
    dch.cost_per_message,
    COUNT(f.communication_id) as total_communications,
    SUM(f.communication_cost) as total_cost,
    SUM(f.converted_count) as total_conversions,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as total_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(f.sale_amount) - SUM(f.communication_cost), 2) as net_profit,
    ROUND((SUM(f.sale_amount) - SUM(f.communication_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(f.communication_cost), 0), 2) as roi_ratio,
    ROUND(SUM(f.sale_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(f.communication_id), 0), 2) as revenue_per_communication,
    SUM(f.converted_count) / COUNT(f.communication_id) as conversion_rate
FROM 
    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
JOIN 
    workspace.crm_info.dim_channel dch ON f.channel_key = dch.channel_id
GROUP BY 
    dch.channel_name, dch.channel_type, dch.cost_per_message
ORDER BY 
    roi_ratio DESC;

datasets.name: c384cc08
datasets.displayName: Customer Engagement and Sales Metrics by Product Category
queryLines:
SELECT 
    dp.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key) as unique_customers,
    COUNT(f.communication_id) as communications_sent,
    SUM(f.delivered_count) as delivered,
    SUM(f.opened_count) as opened,
    SUM(f.clicked_count) as clicked,
    SUM(f.converted_count) as conversions,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(f.sale_amount), 2) as avg_sale_amount,
    SUM(f.converted_count) / COUNT(f.communication_id) as conversion_rate,
    SUM(f.clicked_count) / NULLIF(SUM(f.opened_count), 0) as click_through_rate

    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
JOIN 
    workspace.crm_info.dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_id
GROUP BY 
    dp.category
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC;

datasets.name: 404b5a1f
datasets.displayName: Customer Engagement Metrics by Segment and Region
queryLines:
SELECT 
    dc.segment,
    dc.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key) as customers_reached,
    COUNT(f.communication_id) as communications_sent,

    SUM(f.converted_count) as total_conversions,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as total_revenue,

    workspace.crm_info.dim_customer dc ON f.customer_key = dc.customer_id

    dc.segment, dc.region
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC;

datasets.name: 6070bed0
queryLines:
WITH funnel_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(f.communication_id) as total_sent,
        SUM(f.delivered_count) as total_delivered,
        SUM(f.opened_count) as total_opened,
        SUM(f.clicked_count) as total_clicked,
        SUM(f.converted_count) as total_converted,
        AVG(CASE WHEN f.converted_count > 0 THEN f.days_to_sale END) as avg_days_to_conversion
    FROM 
        workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
)
SELECT 
    'Sent' as stage,
    total_sent as count,
    100.0 as percent_of_sent,
    NULL as conversion_rate
FROM funnel_metrics

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Delivered' as stage,
    total_delivered as count,
    total_delivered / total_sent * 100.0 as percent_of_sent,
    NULL as conversion_rate
FROM funnel_metrics

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Opened' as stage,
    total_opened as count,
    total_opened / total_sent * 100.0 as percent_of_sent,
    total_opened / NULLIF(total_delivered, 0) as conversion_rate
FROM funnel_metrics

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Clicked' as stage,
    total_clicked as count,
    total_clicked / total_sent * 100.0 as percent_of_sent,
    total_clicked / NULLIF(total_opened, 0) as conversion_rate
FROM funnel_metrics

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'Converted' as stage,
    total_converted as count,
    total_converted / total_sent * 100.0 as percent_of_sent,
    total_converted / NULLIF(total_clicked, 0) as conversion_rate
FROM funnel_metrics

ORDER BY 
    CASE stage 
        WHEN 'Sent' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Delivered' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Opened' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Clicked' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Converted' THEN 5
    END;

datasets.name: overall_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT

  SUM(f.converted_count) as total_conversions,
  SUM(f.converted_count) / COUNT(f.communication_id) as overall_conversion_rate,
  SUM(f.sale_amount) as total_revenue,
  SUM(f.communication_cost) as total_cost,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(f.sale_amount) - SUM(f.communication_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(f.communication_cost), 0),

datasets.name: a693f9e9
queryLines:
WITH customer_frequency AS (
  SELECT
    f.customer_key,
    COUNT(*) as communications_received,
    SUM(f.converted_count) as conversions,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as total_revenue
  FROM
    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
  GROUP BY
    f.customer_key
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN communications_received <= 5 THEN '1-5'
    WHEN communications_received <= 10 THEN '6-10'
    WHEN communications_received <= 20 THEN '11-20'
    ELSE '20+'
  END as frequency_bucket,
  COUNT(*) as customers,
  AVG(conversions) as avg_conversions,
  SUM(conversions) / SUM(communications_received) as conversion_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(total_revenue) / COUNT(*), 2) as revenue_per_customer
FROM
  customer_frequency
GROUP BY
  frequency_bucket
ORDER BY
  CASE frequency_bucket
    WHEN '1-5' THEN 1
    WHEN '6-10' THEN 2
    WHEN '11-20' THEN 3
    WHEN '20+' THEN 4
  END

datasets.name: moving_avg_trends
queryLines:
WITH daily_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    dd.date,
    COUNT(f.communication_id) as daily_communications,
    SUM(f.converted_count) as daily_conversions,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as daily_revenue,
    SUM(f.converted_count) / NULLIF(COUNT(f.communication_id), 0) as daily_conversion_rate
  FROM
    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
      JOIN workspace.crm_info.dim_date dd
        ON f.date_key = dd.date_key
  WHERE
    dd.date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  GROUP BY
    dd.date
)
SELECT
  date,
  daily_communications,
  daily_conversions,
  daily_revenue,
  daily_conversion_rate,
  ROUND(
    AVG(daily_communications) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
    2
  ) as ma7_communications,
  ROUND(
    AVG(daily_conversions) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
    2
  ) as ma7_conversions,
  ROUND(
    AVG(daily_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
    2
  ) as ma7_revenue,
  ROUND(
    AVG(daily_conversion_rate) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
    2
  ) as ma7_conversion_rate
FROM
  daily_metrics
ORDER BY
  date DESC

datasets.name: campaign_efficiency
queryLines:
SELECT
  dc.campaign_name,
  dch.channel_name,
  SUM(f.communication_cost) AS total_cost,
  SUM(f.converted_count) AS conversions,
  SUM(f.sale_amount) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(f.communication_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(f.converted_count), 0), 2) AS cost_per_conversion,
  ROUND(SUM(f.sale_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(f.converted_count), 0), 2) AS revenue_per_conversion,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(f.sale_amount) - SUM(f.communication_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(f.communication_cost), 0),
    2
  ) AS roi_ratio,
  CASE
    WHEN
      ROUND(SUM(f.communication_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(f.converted_count), 0), 2) < 1.0
      AND ROUND(SUM(f.sale_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(f.converted_count), 0), 2) > 20000
    THEN
      'High Efficiency'
    WHEN
      ROUND(SUM(f.communication_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(f.converted_count), 0), 2) > 5.0
      AND ROUND(SUM(f.sale_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(f.converted_count), 0), 2) < 20000
    THEN
      'Low Efficiency'
    ELSE 'Medium Efficiency'
  END AS efficiency_category
FROM
  workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
    JOIN workspace.crm_info.dim_campaign dc
      ON f.campaign_key = dc.campaign_id
    JOIN workspace.crm_info.dim_channel dch
      ON f.channel_key = dch.channel_id
GROUP BY
  dc.campaign_name,
  dch.channel_name
HAVING
  conversions > 10

datasets.name: ltv_impact
queryLines:
WITH customer_ltv_segments AS (
  SELECT
    dc.customer_id,
    dc.segment,
    dc.region,
    dc.lifetime_value,
    CASE
      WHEN dc.lifetime_value >= 75000 THEN 'High LTV (75K+)'
      WHEN dc.lifetime_value >= 50000 THEN 'Medium LTV (50-75K)'
      WHEN dc.lifetime_value >= 25000 THEN 'Low LTV (25-50K)'
      ELSE 'Very Low LTV (<25K)'
    END as ltv_segment
  FROM
    workspace.crm_info.dim_customer dc
)
SELECT
  cls.ltv_segment,
  cls.segment as customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key) as customers_reached,
  COUNT(f.communication_id) as total_communications,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(f.communication_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key),
    1
  ) as avg_comms_per_customer,
  SUM(f.converted_count) as conversions,
  SUM(f.converted_count) / COUNT(f.communication_id) as conversion_rate,
  SUM(f.sale_amount) as total_revenue,
  ROUND(AVG(cls.lifetime_value), 2) as avg_ltv,
  ROUND(SUM(f.sale_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key), 0), 2) as revenue_per_customer
FROM
  workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
    JOIN customer_ltv_segments cls
      ON f.customer_key = cls.customer_id
GROUP BY
  cls.ltv_segment,
  cls.segment
ORDER BY
  avg_ltv DESC

datasets.name: cohort_analysis
datasets.displayName: Customer Cohort Analysis by First Contact Month
queryLines:
WITH first_contact AS (
  SELECT
    customer_key,
    MIN(event_date) as first_contact_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', MIN(event_date)) as cohort_month
  FROM
    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication
  GROUP BY
    customer_key
),
cohort_activity AS (
  SELECT
    fc.cohort_month,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.event_date) as activity_month,
    CAST(
      FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(f.event_date, fc.first_contact_date)) AS INT
    ) as months_since_first_contact,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key) as active_customers,
    SUM(f.converted_count) as conversions,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as revenue
  FROM
    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
      JOIN first_contact fc
        ON f.customer_key = fc.customer_key
  GROUP BY
    fc.cohort_month,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', f.event_date),
    CAST(FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(f.event_date, fc.first_contact_date)) AS INT)
),
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT
    cohort_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) as cohort_size
  FROM
    first_contact
  GROUP BY
    cohort_month
)
SELECT
  ca.cohort_month,
  ca.activity_month,
  ca.months_since_first_contact,
  cs.cohort_size,
  ca.active_customers,
  ca.active_customers / cs.cohort_size as retention_rate,
  ca.conversions,
  ROUND(ca.revenue, 2) as revenue
FROM
  cohort_activity ca
    JOIN cohort_size cs
      ON ca.cohort_month = cs.cohort_month
ORDER BY
  ca.cohort_month,
  ca.months_since_first_contact

datasets.name: revenue_forecast_combined
queryLines:
WITH historical_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    dd.date as forecast_date,
    SUM(f.sale_amount) as revenue,
    NULL as revenue_lower,
    NULL as revenue_upper,
    'Historical' as data_type
  FROM
    workspace.crm_info.fact_crm_communication f
      JOIN workspace.crm_info.dim_date dd
        ON f.date_key = dd.date_key
  WHERE
    dd.date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  GROUP BY
    dd.date
),
forecast_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(forecast_date AS DATE) as forecast_date,
    predicted_revenue as revenue,
    revenue_lower,
    revenue_upper,
    'Forecast' as data_type
  FROM
    workspace.crm_info.forecast_campaign_performance
  WHERE
    forecast_date >= CURRENT_DATE
),
last_historical AS (
  SELECT
    forecast_date,
    revenue,
    NULL as revenue_lower,
    NULL as revenue_upper,
    'Forecast' as data_type
  FROM
    historical_revenue
  ORDER BY
    forecast_date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  historical_revenue
UNION ALL
SELECT
  *
FROM
  last_historical
UNION ALL
SELECT
  *
FROM
  forecast_data
ORDER BY
  forecast_date

lines:
## CRM Dashboard

This dashboard analyzes customer engagement and campaign effectiveness across various channel communications: email, SMS, call and push notification.

The objective is to identify the most profitable campaigns, optimize channel allocations, improve customer conversion, and forecast future revenue performance.

### Key insights:

- **Top Finding**: Push Notification delivers exceptional ROI at 360,236%, despite being lowest volume (474 communications), driven by minimal cost ($0.01/message) and strong 17.9% conversion rate
- **Channel Strategy**: Email dominates with 2731 communications and $11.5M revenue, but SMS achieves the highest conversion rate (17.7%) with 3x lower cost than calls
- **Product Performance**: Loans category generates 95% of total revenue ($25M of $26M) with average sale of $124K, while other categories contribute volume but minimal revenue
- **Cohort Trend**: Customers contacted in May 2026 show 57.9% retention after 1 month, suggesting strong early engagement opportunity
**📅 Daily Update Schedule**: This dashboard is configured to refresh daily at 6:00 AM UTC via scheduled dataset refresh. All metrics reflect data through the previous business day.
